This file ships with no entries. Data belongs beside the library it applies to:
<workspace>/pdk/<kit>/alias-map.json      — searched FIRST, wins over this file
next to that folder's device-provider.json. Same format either way:
Passed to the worker as its second argument on every platform; the Windows launcher forwards its
whole command line to the same crf_worker_main the Linux build runs.
A library with no entry is unaffected: every node stays an ordinary unknown, which is the correct
default. Supply an entry only where a node is not an independent unknown — solving for one that
is not makes the system singular, and the symptom is a bias ramp that stalls and grinds rather
A key is treated as a family only if its value is an OBJECT. That is why this note is an array:
a reader that took the first quoted string it saw would file every alias under "_note", load the
right NUMBER of entries under the wrong NAME, and the lookup would silently never match.
Entries are node -> master integer pairs. Anything that cannot be parsed is skipped, so a
malformed file degrades to "no aliases" rather than to a wrong one.
